sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Disinclined to mental work. Tight feeling,
as if compressed by a rubber band. [Gels.; Mahonia.]
Orbital neuralgia over right eye. Headache, better, by
green tea; while smoking.

sections.label: Nose
sections.text:
Smell very acute. Putrid discharge. Ozjcna,
with fetor and ulceration. Influenza and resulting de-
bility. [Bapt.: Nat. .^ulph.]

sections.label: Throat
sections.text:
Ulcerated patches on inside of lips and
cheeks. Burning in mouth to stomach. Fauces red, and
covered with exudation. Uvula whitened and shriveled.
Putrid discharge. Almost impossible to swallow. Diph-
theria, fetid breath, regurgitation on swallowing liquids,
but little pain. [Bapt.] Face dusky red; white about
mouth and nose. Rapid sinking of vital forces.


201

sections.label: Stomach
sections.text:
Appetite lost. Desire for stimulants and
tobacco. Constant belching, nausea, vomiting, dark
olive green. Heat rises up oesophagus. Flatulent dis-
tention of stomach and abdomen. Painful flatulence
often marked in one part of the bowel. [Sulpko-Car^
bolate of Soda.]

Stoo-L — Constipation, with very offensive breath.
Bloody, like scrapings of intestines. Great tenesmus.
Diarrhoea ; stools thin, black, putrid.

sections.label: Urine
sections.text:
Almost black. Diabetes. Irritable bladder
in old men with frequent urination at night, of prob-
able prostatic nature.

sections.label: Female
sections.text:
Discharges always offensive. [Nitr. ac.;
Nux. V.; ..9c/’.] Pustules about vulva containing bloody
pus. Agonizing backache across loins, with dragging-
down thighs. Pain in left ovary; worse walking in
open air. Erosions of cervix; fetid, acrid discharge.
Leucorrhoea in children. [Ccm;r. s.; Merc.; Puls.:
Sep.] Puerperal fever, with offensive discharge. Ir-
ritating leucorrhoea, causing itching and burning.
{Kreos.]

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Cramps in fore part of leg, close to
tibia during walking. Gnawing pains in shin bones.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Itching vesicles, with burning pain. Burns
tend to ulcerate.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:
Compare: Chrysarobin (locally in
ringworm of the scalp S-10 per cent, in glycerine and
alcohol. Equal parts). Ars.; Kreosot.; Carbo; Gtuino.
(Violent headache as from a band around head. Itch-
ing of nostrils, back, thighs, genitals. Symptoms like
hay-fever.)

Antidote: Vinegar; Chalk; led.

Incompatible: Glycerine and vegetable oils.
